- Surface clearer blocked/failed self-approval statuses for preflight, parser, metadata, and approval API failure paths.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #186 implements the operational-polish slice from issue #185 under parent plan #170.
- It adds marker-based self-approval status upsert, scoped to comments authored by the authenticated Sepo actor.
- It improves blocked/failed status visibility for metadata, provenance, parser, and approval API failure paths.
- It also keeps status/artifact workflow paths alive with `always()` where appropriate and adds focused regression coverage.

## Review
The implementation is largely aligned with the requested scope, and two reviewers found no actionable issues. One concrete workflow edge case remains: the stop-status step can now run before `prepare` has produced a status body.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Stop status can post duplicate generic comments after setup failures | WARNING | The `Post self-approval stop` step now uses `always()` and can run when checkout/auth/runtime setup fails before `prepare` executes. With no `BODY_FILE`, `post-response` posts a generic non-marker comment, bypassing the upsert path. |

## Progress
- Codex review reported no findings and verified the focused build/test set.
- Rubrics review passed and found no rubric-specific follow-up.
- Posted one inline comment on `.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml:81`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/186#discussion_r3212143788
- No replies were added and no comments were minimized.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Stop status can post duplicate generic comments after setup failures</summary>

**Cause:**  
`always() && steps.prepare.outputs.should_run != 'true'` is also true when `prepare` was skipped because an earlier setup step failed. In that case `steps.prepare.outputs.body_file` is empty, so `post-response.ts` falls back to a generic body that does not contain the self-approval marker.

**Candidate solutions:**  
Add a guard proving `prepare` actually ran before posting the stop status, such as checking the prepare step outcome in addition to `should_run`. Keep the intended path where `prepare` itself fails or blocks and emits a status body.

**Comments:**  
This is the only meaningful reviewer disagreement: Codex and rubrics considered the PR shippable, while Claude identified this low-impact but real duplicate-comment edge case.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the remaining concern is a concrete workflow guard change that is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Guard `Post self-approval stop` so it only posts when the `prepare` step actually ran and produced the intended stop/status path.

## Summary of PR/Issue

The previous workflow-stop finding was fixed, but one idempotency edge case remains in the marker-upsert fallback. Claude and rubrics judged the current head shippable; Codex identified the remaining warning below.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Upsert failures can still create duplicate self-approval comments | WARNING | `post-response.ts` catches marker-upsert failures and then falls through to `postResponse`, which creates a fresh marker comment. If lookup or PATCH failed transiently, reruns can duplicate status comments instead of preserving the upsert contract. |

## Progress
- The prior `Post self-approval stop` guard issue is fixed at current head with `steps.prepare.outcome == 'success'` and `body_file != ''`.

- No replies were added.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Upsert failures can still create duplicate self-approval comments</summary>

**Cause:**  
The self-approval marker path sets `posted = true` only after `upsertPrCommentByMarker` succeeds. If fetching authenticated actor/comment records or PATCHing the existing marker comment throws, the catch logs a warning and the final `if (!posted)` block posts a new marker-bearing PR comment.

**Candidate solutions:**  
For marker-bearing self-approval bodies, treat an upsert exception as terminal for posting: fail the step, set `posted = true` after logging, or split the helper contract so creating a new comment only happens after a successful lookup proves no trusted marker comment exists.

**Comments:**  
This preserves the PR’s idempotent user-facing automation contract. Claude noted only optional future hardening for a lower-probability empty-body resolver crash path; the required branch-change item is the upsert fallback behavior above.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the unresolved finding is a concrete, localized branch change in `post-response.ts` that is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Prevent marker-bearing self-approval statuses from falling back to a fresh PR comment when the upsert attempt throws.
